column11: Two shares multiplied. On vasopressors: of the 173,690 sepsis cases in Rhee's 2014 cohort, 49,400 had vasopressors initiated (Rhee 2017, Figure 1), 28.44%, which is SERENIA's shock entry condition (vasopressor or inotrope for 4 hours or more). AKI in septic shock: 64.4% of 4,532 adults with septic shock developed AKI within 24 hours of hypotension by RIFLE, whose lowest grade is creatinine 1.5 times baseline, SERENIA's own threshold (Bagshaw SM et al., Intensive Care Med 2009;35:871-881, PMID 19066848, 22 ICUs in Canada, the US and Saudi Arabia). 0.284415 x 0.644 = 0.183163, 311,377 patients a year
column12: Leans low: Bagshaw counts AKI in the first 24 hours where SERENIA takes 72 hours from the sepsis diagnosis. Leans high: SERENIA excludes patients over 80, active cancer, CKD stage 4 or 5 and sepsis diagnosed more than 7 days into a stay; the label is taken to cover adults with SA-AKI, not the trial's exclusions. The two shares come from different cohorts and are multiplied as if AKI were as common in Rhee's vasopressor cases as in Bagshaw's septic shock

Giapreza's US net sales were $71.8mm in 2025 (Innoviva FY2025 10-K, 0001193125-26-071776). At its $3,000 course (2 vials at the $1,500 WAC, 83 FR 41144) less the same 5.66%, $2,830.19 net, that is 25,369 courses. Pool: 1,700,000 sepsis hospitalisations x 28.44% on vasopressors (Rhee 2017) = 483,505. Capture: 25,369 / 483,505 = 5.247% in Giapreza's eighth year on sale, still rising: $23.1mm in 2019 (1.69%), $33.4mm in 2021 (2.44%), $53.4mm in 2024 (3.90%) (La Jolla FY2019 10-K 0000920465-20-000036 and FY2021 10-K 0001564590-22-009182, Innoviva FY2024 10-K 0000950170-25-027864). MULTIPLE 1.0, A JUDGEMENT. CROSS-CHECK at this seed's price: Terlivaz sold $24.7mm in the US in 2024 and $8.2mm more in 2025, $32.9mm (Mallinckrodt FY2024 10-K 0001567892-25-000010, Keenova FY2025 10-K 0001628280-26-025238), 1,360 courses at $24,198.11 net, 5.0% of the 27,180 US hepatorenal syndrome hospitalisations of 2019 (Singal AK et al., Aliment Pharmacol Ther 2022;56:1486-1496, PMID 36196562) in its third full year
column12: the 1.0 multiple is a judgement and the most arguable figure here. Case for more: AZD4144 would be labelled for every SA-AKI patient where Giapreza is a rescue once vasopressors fail; against the 150,000 to 230,000 patients a year La Jolla counts as failing current vasopressors (FY2021 10-K), Giapreza's 25,369 courses are 11% to 17%. Case against: no medicine has yet shown benefit in SA-AKI, SERENIA reads creatinine clearance with no outcome data, and at 8.55 times Giapreza's price a hospital pays for it inside a fixed DRG. Giapreza's courses are counted at its 2018 WAC, so a later price rise means fewer courses and a lower capture, and La Jolla puts non-septic shock under 10% of the distributive shock Giapreza treats
